summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for the SpaceXSI Console, described as the gateway to the Grok API and developer tools. According to the page, it lets developers get API keys and use Grok models for chat, voice, image generation, and real-time search. The page text is mostly cookie-consent boilerplate and gives no details on pricing, rate limits, SDKs, or specific model names. The listing notes it is linked from xAI resources including news, API docs, and GitHub.
